entities.summary: Moyobamba or Muyupampa, also called "Santiago of eight valleys of Moyobamba" or "Maynas capital", is the capital city of the San Martín Region in northern Peru. There are 50,073 inhabitants, according to the 2017 census. Some 3,500 species of orchids are native to the area, which has led to another of the city's nicknames, The City of Orchids. The city is the capital of both Moyobamba Province and Moyobamba District.
